Hi — my professional home base is **Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central / Navision** development. Alongside that, I'm pursuing a Master's degree in AI-oriented software engineering, and AI is where my curiosity truly lives: I spend much of my free time studying and researching it.

This site has two parts: a personal introduction (CV, experience) and a **learning space** collecting what I learn, both course by course in my Master's program and through my own self-study.

### Areas of interest

- **Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central / Navision** — ERP development, customization, and integrations, built through hands-on project work in professional settings
- **AI/ML** — self-directed study and research spanning foundations to applied projects, now structured around a Master's program in AI-oriented software engineering, with a growing focus on computer vision (both classical CV and deep learning)

👉 See the [learning space by subject](courses/index.qmd) or the [full CV](about.qmd).
